title: Visible PvP button does not load the PvP domain on first use

environment.browser: Safari target; automated regression uses Playwright Chromium with iPhone UA and 390x844 touch viewport
environment.surface: Quick Actions launcher -> visible Luxe PvP button

reproduction: Open KELO WORLD from a cold page load where the PvP domain has not been loaded yet.
Open the visible Quick Actions launcher.
Observe that the button asks KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp').
On the broken build, ensure('pvp') resolves after loading only combat foundations, while enterPvPWorld is still absent.
The UI then falls through to the 'PvP todavía cargando' path instead of entering the PvP world.
expected: The first visible PVP tap loads the complete PvP first-use domain, installs enterPvPWorld, enters mode=pvp and enables combat without putting the full PvP domain into initial boot.
actual: The pre-fix module loader treated combat foundations as sufficient for the pvp feature and did not load pvp-world.js or pvp-combat-runtime-loader.js, so the visible button could finish loading without an enterPvPWorld function.
evidence: src/ui/luxe-shell.js visible button handler calls KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp') then checks window.enterPvPWorld.
Pre-fix src/core/module-loader.js special-cased pvp by calling only KeloRuntimeBootstrap.ensure().
src/systems/pvp-combat-runtime-loader.js requires an existing KeloPvPWorld and installs the enterPvPWorld lazy facade.
Candidate commits c4ed65b765bc976a01b5cf39ddcee3c6ea5151af and 6b85c07bc5349c4b6d304a97ccf85c19f1ea7ea7 implement the first-use feature contract.
GitHub Actions run 35059145087: mobile iPhone-UA visible Quick Actions -> PVP flow and desktop flow both passed; mode became pvp, combatEnabled=true, loaderReady=true and pvpReady=true.
GitHub Actions run 35059145087: dodge completed exactly 112 px with no collision hits or page errors on both mobile and desktop.
GitHub Actions run 35059145087: strict iPhone 390x844 touch walk passed 8 s + 10 s idle + 4 s walk with every timed page.evaluate <=400 ms and no crash.
GitHub Actions run 35059145087: Foundation, Docs, bug registry, bug reports, bug regression, bug close and bug recurrence gates passed.
owner_hint: KeloModuleLoader first-use lifecycle delegating gameplay ownership to KeloPvPWorld

research.summary: The gameplay owner and visible button handler were already correct. The defect was the feature lifecycle contract: ensure('pvp') loaded only shared combat foundations, not the PvP domain that defines enterPvPWorld. The candidate registers PvP as a real first-use feature pack and keeps KeloPvPWorld as gameplay owner. Automated cold-load regression is green; real Safari hardware remains the stronger final external verification while BrowserStack capacity is unavailable.

known_facts.statement: The visible Luxe PVP button calls KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp') when loader.needs('pvp') is true, then calls enterPvPWorld only if that function exists.
evidence: src/ui/luxe-shell.js

known_facts.statement: Before the candidate fix, KELO_MODULE_LOADER.ensure('pvp') returned KeloRuntimeBootstrap.ensure() and did not load the PvP domain scripts.
evidence: src/core/module-loader.js before 6b85c07bc5349c4b6d304a97ccf85c19f1ea7ea7

known_facts.statement: pvp-combat-runtime-loader.js does not create KeloPvPWorld; it requires KeloPvPWorld to already exist and then publishes enterPvPWorld.
evidence: src/systems/pvp-combat-runtime-loader.js

known_facts.statement: The PvP control is intentionally inside the collapsed Quick Actions menu; a valid visible regression must open #kw-quick-actions-toggle before clicking #lx-side-pvp.
evidence: src/ui/luxe-player-hud.js
GitHub Actions harness investigation on PR #292

known_facts.statement: The final automated regression passed the cold first-use transition from loaderReady=false to loaderReady=true with KeloPvPWorld mode=pvp and combatEnabled=true.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 35059145087

known_facts.statement: The strict iPhone-UA 390x844 sustained-walk firewall passed with all timed page.evaluate calls at or below 400 ms and no crash.
evidence: GitHub Actions run 35059145087

hypotheses.theory: The first-use feature contract is incomplete: combat foundations are being mistaken for a fully loaded PvP domain.
hypotheses.why: The visible button waits on ensure('pvp'), while the pre-fix ensure implementation never loaded the files that define KeloPvPWorld/enterPvPWorld; after making PvP an explicit first-use pack, the same visible flow passes from a cold load.
hypotheses.test_next: Real iPhone Safari smoke when BrowserStack Automate capacity is available or via direct player QA.

ruled_out.theory: The visible button has no PvP handler.
ruled_out.reason: The handler exists and correctly requests the pvp feature before calling enterPvPWorld.
evidence: src/ui/luxe-shell.js

ruled_out.theory: The PvP failure is caused only by the account/auth overlay.
ruled_out.reason: The isolated guest regression still required opening the intentionally collapsed Quick Actions menu; once the real UI path was reproduced, the PvP lifecycle candidate passed.
evidence: F4
GitHub Actions runs preceding 35059145087
